name: Jonathan Christyadi
tagline: Building full-stack applications, backend systems and applied AI software.
bio: I build software around the difficult middle: the services, interfaces, data models and operational details that make a useful idea dependable. My work moves between full-stack product development, backend architecture and applied AI systems.
approach: I like systems that make complexity legible. That means clear boundaries, useful interfaces and an honest preference for the smallest solution that can carry the work.
